rationale: It describes consumer/business datasets and targeting, but the method behind ‘intelligent marketing solutions’ is unexplained, leaving the nature of those solutions uncertain.
evidence_spans: We use our expansive data and technology platforms to help companies more accurately target their ideal customers and provide intelligent marketing solutions.
conflict_response: No concern requires changing the provisional negative, but ‘intelligent’ and more accurate targeting do not establish AI or a particular conventional implementation. The ambiguous marketing-solution method warrants the retained weak/forced judgment.
